navigation_pattern: Bottom tab bar (5 tabs) as root for a 6-screen app: (1) Home Scan Dashboard, (2) Scan, (3) Inventory, (4) Reports, (5) Settings; plus (6) Item Detail reachable by drill-down. Tab bar floats above content at bottom, always visible, badge support, large-content variants. Drill-down via UINavigationController stack with system chevron back button and centered title; max 2 right-side actions. Modal/dialog: sheets (inline sheet, full-screen cover) for focused tasks; action sheets for destructive choices; alerts (never more than one visible) for confirmation; popovers for inline editing. Keep modals short; restore focus to the triggering control after a sheet closes.
card_pattern: Elevated cards on systemGroupedBackground (#F5F5F7 light / #1D1D1F dark), no borders, radius 16pt, 16pt internal padding, shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.22) 3px 5px 30px 0 only when elevated; most elements use color-contrast elevation, not shadow. List cells use default style; custom card list via .listRowSeparator(.hidden) + clear backgrounds. Bento grid in Reports: 4-column, tiles span 1-2 columns, consistent 24pt gap, large radius 16, 1px inset border for premium depth. Tab/segmented: bottom tab bar 3-5 items with SF Symbols + labels, active = filled + tint; segmented control (max 5-7 segments) for close subviews like scan result tabs, prefer text-only or image-only, equal widths. Empty states: ContentUnavailableView with large symbol, title2-bold, footnote subtitle; search variant shows 'No results for x' with search icon; inline variant when in search.
micro_interactions: Button press: opacity 0.7 + scale 0.98, instant (<=100ms); no z-axis scale/perspective, fade only.
Haptics: light impact for toggles, medium for primary actions, success impact for confirmations; selection feedback on tap.
Swipe gestures on list rows: archive/delete with immediate feedback; pull-to-refresh with spring overshoot.
Focus: halo ring on keyboard/remote navigation (iPad); match system focus model, don't invent rings.
Search: inline recent searches on focus, suggestions below field; no results -> ContentUnavailableView with current query text.
Skeleton loading: placeholder layout with ghosted content, zero layout shift when data lands; replace after <400ms.
Navigation transitions: push spring (damping 20, stiffness 200); modal sheet drag; exit direction mirrors entry.
Scroll edge effect: tab bar blurs/opacity-reduces content beneath on scroll; expands on scroll up.
Tab switch: quick fade + spring; tab bar shrinks on scroll (iOS 26 Liquid Glass).

Platform reference points: Apple = SF Pro + Liquid Glass + haptics, no borders, shadow sparingly; Android = Material 3 (color runtime themes, 4dp grid, elevation shadows), Roboto/Inter; Web = SF/Inter via CSS variables, glass via backdrop-filter, bento via CSS Grid; Web lacks haptics, mirror press with scale+opacity.
